spec.hypothesis: taker_imbalance (EFMA 2025 order-flow) FAILED cleanly on majors (sprint05, n=1840,t=-46.6) and liquid-8-alts (sprint13, n=7269,t=-80.2) with correctly-keyed params. sprint22/23's 'reversion' cells never actually ran (CONFIRMED param-key mismatch -- silently used continuation defaults). Microstructure literature (Liu-Tsyvinski et al., cited sprint18/26/34) predicts order-flow effects concentrate in smaller, less-liquid, higher-turnover names -- this is the last untested cell in the matrix for this signal.
spec.power_argument: Dispersion ~33bp std, T2 cost floor ~26bp (C0/C1) -> min detectable edge at n=300,t=2 ~3.8bp. 8 symbols x ~92 validation days x cap8/day = up to 5888 possible entries; sprint34 (same basket, cap8, accounting for BTCSTUSDT/MATICUSDT gaps) realized 1616 validation trades, and sprint05's z>1.5 threshold fired ~920 times/symbol/92d on liquid pairs, so n>=300 is near-certain.
